stories.title: Fibroblast alignment guides intestinal epithelial wound closure
stories.takeaway: Physical stromal guidance complements biochemical repair signals.
stories.what_happened: An engineered gap-closure model showed that aligned fibroblasts and their deposited matrix guide coordinated organoid-derived epithelial migration.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides a tractable approach to studying intestinal restitution.
stories.caveat: Model findings require validation in living human tissue.

stories.title: Defined synthetic matrices separate intestinal organoid responses to stiffness and adhesion
stories.takeaway: Defined substrates permit controlled investigation of matrix-dependent cell states.
stories.what_happened: Researchers replaced animal-derived matrix with recombinant substrates and PEG hydrogels and compared epithelial and mesenchymal responses.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for reproducible organoid culture and fibrosis modeling.
stories.caveat: The organoids retained fetal-like transcriptional characteristics.

stories.title: Microfluidic engineering across the organoid workflow
stories.takeaway: Perfusion and sensing address distinct limitations of static organoid culture.
stories.what_happened: A review maps droplet generation, confinement, perfusion, mechanical stimulation and integrated sensing to organoid engineering needs.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for comparing platform architectures and monitoring strategies.
stories.caveat: A review does not establish comparative performance across devices.
